channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about VJ Edgecombe | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about VJ Edgecombe from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mike Gansey on VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
Gansey on V.J. Edgecombe's leadership:

“V.J. has no fear, that’s what I love about him. Like, he’s a super competitor, but he’ll also tell you what’s on his mind and he’s obviously a high-IQ basketball player. So when he talks about something, you’re listening because he knows what he’s talking about. But the talent level is obviously elite. I mean, he does, like, you know, he’s had plays in practice where it’s game point and he blocks someone at the rim for the game. He gets a loose ball for…that’s flying out of bounds. He gets a rebound that wins a game. He just does all the little things and intangibles and he’s just a winning player. And the thing I love about him, too, like I said, no fear and he just competes at a high level.”

Mike Gansey on VJ Edgecombe, Oct 3, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyrese Maxey on VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
Adam Aaronson:Tyrese Maxey on his advice to VJ Edgecombe:

“He's going to be extremely important for us... We're going to need his energy every single day. You're going to have to be the same person every single night... I think he's up for it. We're built kind of the same... I'm extremely proud of him.”

Tyrese Maxey on VJ Edgecombe, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Labaron Philon on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
“Just being a rookie and being able to be around all those guys is a privilege for me. You don’t get to see a rookie get to play with five guys that can potentially make an All-Star team [James, Brown, Tyrese Maxey, Joel Embiid, and VJ Edgecombe]. I feel like you can learn every day, and every day you can compete against them to get better.”

Labaron Philon on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Aug 3, 2026. Source: The Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: Channing Frye on Kyle Lowry, Kawhi Leonard, Nick Nurse, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
Channing Frye:

“Nick Nurse, one thing that's not taking into consideration is Nick Nurse is a beast. And so when you add all these personalities to a team, Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, you know, Bron, VJ Edgecombe, you know, Jaylen Brown, you need a coach that can handle all that that's going to put them in the right situation. A lot of them, everyone's going to talk about usage rate, but Nick Nurse made it work in Toronto with, you know, OG Anunoby, Pascal Siakam, Kyle Lowry and Kawhi Leonard.”

Channing Frye on Kyle Lowry, Kawhi Leonard, Nick Nurse, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Jul 28, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Draymond Green on VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“If I'm VJ Edgecombe's agent, I'm not sure I'm happy with the summer that the 76ers have had because this could affect a lot for VJ Edgecombe. Like you go from being sometimes the second option when Embiid was out to sometimes being the fifth option. It's a big, big, big difference. I don't know if y'all understand like how big of a difference that is.”

Draymond Green on VJ Edgecombe, Jul 28, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Josh Harris on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
Managing Partner Josh Harris said.

“I cannot wait to see LeBron alongside Jaylen Brown, VJ Edgecombe, Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, and our talented roster as we work to deliver a championship for Philly. To LeBron and his family: we are grateful you chose the 76ers, and look forward to this next chapter of your legendary career. Welcome to the 76ers!”

Josh Harris on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Jul 27, 2026. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Nick Nurse on VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
Derek Bodner:Nick Nurse, on VJ Edgecombe's rookie season:

“That was a hell of an impressive rookie season. He's a hell of a player. It's not about shooting, scoring, jumping, all that stuff. He really knows how to play. He really has a leadership quality to him. I think he's a bigtime winner.”

Nick Nurse on VJ Edgecombe, May 10, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Tyrese Maxey on VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
Derek Bodner:Tyrese Maxey, on VJ Edgecombe's growth into being more of a perimeter initiator:

“I think next year I'm gonna do some things off the ball, and I don't have to be in front of the defense all the time. When you're in front of the defense, it gives them an opportunity to trap you.”

Tyrese Maxey on VJ Edgecombe, May 10, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
Adam Aaronson:Joe Mazzulla on VJ Edgecombe:

“When he’s at his best, he’s a three-level scorer…He’s gotten better and better during the year.”

Joe Mazzulla on VJ Edgecombe, Apr 24, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Tyrese Maxey on VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
“…We were blessed with VJ Edgecombe,and I think as a Sixers organization, as a fan base, we should be very happy, very pleased, and very thankful. I know I am. I’m extremely thankful for him.”

Tyrese Maxey on VJ Edgecombe, Feb 26, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Nick Nurse on VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
Derek Bodner:Nick Nurse, on VJ Edgecombe's recent struggles, and what they can do to get him back on track offensively:

“We certainly want him to be aggressive…I need to give him some situations where we're saying 'this is for you to attack', and we probably haven't done a good enough job of that.”

Nick Nurse on VJ Edgecombe, Nov 13, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Derrick Rose, VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
Detroit Pistons head coachJB Bickerstaff on what stands out about Sixers rookie VJ Edgecombe:

“The speed, and just how dynamic he is… He reminds me of Derrick Rose when Derrick Rose was young.”

JB Bickerstaff on Derrick Rose, VJ Edgecombe, Nov 9, 2025. Source: Bluesky.
